title: Juicy Crispy Uruguayan Beef Skewers
description: A funky and crispy Uruguayan dish featuring balsamic vinegar and score-fat, perfect for a date night, and friendly to egg-free diets.

ingredients.name: beef strips
ingredients.notes: scored with fat for extra flavor

instructions: Preheat the grill to medium-high heat.
Thread the beef strips onto the skewers, leaving a little space between each piece.
In a small bowl, whisk together the balsamic vinegar, olive oil, garlic powder, salt, black pepper, paprika, and onion powder.
Brush the mixture onto both sides of the beef strips.
Grill the skewers for 8-10 minutes, turning occasionally, until the beef is cooked to the desired level of doneness.
Let the skewers rest for 5 minutes before serving.
Serve the skewers hot, garnished with fresh parsley or thyme if desired.
